newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin recovering well, to appear on tv - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin recovering well, to appear on tv - spokesman.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin is recovering well from pneumonia and will appear on television on Tuesday, spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a news conference.

"My personal impression of the president today is that progress is evident," Yastrzhembsky said. "He was in the Kremlin for three hours and he has gone back to the Gorky-9 (residence) to continue work on papers. He will appear on TV tonight."

Yeltsin, who turns 66 on Saturday, has not been seen on television since he was taken ill with pneumonia on January 6. He spent 12 days in hospital and then moved to Gorky-9 to continue his convalescence.
The Kremlin says he went to the Kremlin on Tuesday, where he met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and Ivan Korotchenya, who coordinates Russian policy toward the former Soviet republics.
Yastrzhembsky said he expected Yeltsin to increase his workload gradually over the coming days and further meetings this week could not be ruled out.
Yeltsin planned to spent his 66th birthday with his family, Yastrzhembsky added.
